newsitem.title: USA: Shopco payout enjoined by Maryland court.
newsitem.headline: Shopco payout enjoined by Maryland court.

text.p: Shopco Laurel Centre LP said Monday it declared a cash distribution of $1.35 per unit, but said distribution of the payment has been enjoined by the Circuit Court for Prince George's County, Md.
It said the declared distribution, which includes a regular $0.125 quarterly payment, is payable October 10 to holders of record September 30.
Shopco last paid $1.625 per unit on August 15.
The partnership said State Street Boston Corp obtained the order enjoining payments, adding Shopco believes the order is without merit and will contest it.
In view of the court order and the upcoming maturity of two mortgage loans on the Laurel Centre Mall on October 15, any future distribvutions will need to be carefully evaluated, it said.
